kids.title: Vietnamese for Kids
kids.desc: Learning through picture flashcards, audio, and gentle review activities.
highlights: Each lesson is a set of 8-15 flashcards: image, vocabulary, pronunciation and a simple example
A gentle review activity follows: picture matching, listen-and-choose, simple multiple choice
Dedicated one-on-one time with a real teacher every session, with progress tracked closely
Suited for kids age 4+ - built around enjoyment, not academic pressure

adults.title: Vietnamese for Adults
adults.desc: Vocabulary, conversation, grammar and speaking practice with a clear path forward.
highlights: Real-life vocabulary and dialogue built around everyday topics
Listening, reading comprehension and grammar explained clearly
Speaking and writing exercises, graded with direct feedback from your teacher
Flexible focus: everyday conversation, travel, reading/writing, or reconnecting with your first language

items.q: What age should my child start?
items.a: The kids' program is designed for ages 4 and up. Your trial class will help us find the right fit for your child's age and current level.
Students meet a teacher on a scheduled video call, plus flashcard lessons and materials in the learning portal to practice in between sessions.

items.q: I don't speak much Vietnamese myself — can I still support my child?
items.a: Absolutely. Everything in the portal includes English support, and you just need to check progress — not teach the material yourself.
We only offer one-on-one classes between a teacher and student, so every session stays focused, paced to you (or your child), and your teacher can truly track individual progress.

items.q: Can you work around our time zone abroad?
items.a: Yes — we prioritize flexible scheduling around each family's time zone.
